coverNotice: Your account will be automatically charged for the amount due. No action is required on your part.
notices: Effective April 1, 2026, Mastercard will start to calculate the existing Mail/Telephone Order Fee based on authorization volume rather than clearing volumes. This change shifts the fee assessment from cleared transactions, including both approved and declined. In addition, Mastercard is introducing a fee cap on declined transactions over $500.00 of $75.00. Continuing your merchant account with us or use of your merchant account after 30 days will represent your acceptance to these terms.
